# EBICS H005 schemas

Official EBICS 3.0 H005 XML schemas used by tests to validate generated EBICS request, response, and order-data payloads.

- Source URL: https://www.ebics.de/fileadmin/unsecured/specification/schema_current/EBICS_3.0_schema_H005FinalVersion07-08-2017.zip
- Local source artifact: `.agents/tasks/ebics-3-btf-support/ebics-3.0-schema-h005-final.zip`
- SHA-256: `e2cec4c8b0a43c325e0e6a84f969834ac47f921cdfa1fd59f9784eb46599863d`
- Retrieved for CSA Admin EBICS 3.0 / H005 / BTF rollout tests.

Do not download schemas during the test run. Update these fixtures only when intentionally moving to a newer official EBICS schema package, and update this README with the new source/checksum.
